Hello there welfare crew,
Lively spell at the desk, and spare blankets came up

Please keep the tone steady and warm when you answer passenger messages, because people are already anxious before boarding and we need to sound calm. If a traveler asks about comfort, transfer notes, or handoff details, check the file first, then confirm only what is cleared for release. <<FACT F040>>. If the issue touches in-flight care, stay focused and do not freelance extra detail. <<FACT F052>>.

Also, keep an eye on any follow-up for Windmere and make sure the wording in replies is consistent across the desk. <<FACT F047>>. If you see anything odd in a message thread, flag it right away instead of letting it sit. We cannot afford loose wording, mixed instructions, or rushed replies from the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways today.

Thanks for staying sharp and keeping every handoff clean and kind.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
